answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through memory-hard challenges timed to a periodic network pulse. Each node must prove continuous VRAM occupancy via latency-critical matrix lookups that prevent hardware multiplexing. An attacker incurs the verifiable capital cost of dedicated accelerator memory per fake sparrow identity. However, this excludes honest edge devices with footprints as modest as a walnut, and it cannot deter adversaries leasing massive GPU clusters.
